observations.why: Imperative directive enacting authority-ranking: speaker commands erasure of knowledge, a rank-based allocation of what may be retained.
Second imperative command to purge information, reinforcing the same authority-ranking move of directing what the recipient may know.

mints.name: DirectiveKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: Forget everything about … Remove all knowledge
mints.frame: Is authority here being enacted by commanding the recipient to purge what they know?
